title: Install scaffold & verify deps
desc: Bring up the agent-workflows scaffold in a fresh dev container and confirm everything imports cleanly.
ac:
`uv sync` succeeds against the provided pyproject.toml.
`uv run pytest tests/test_smoke.py` passes (no LLM calls required).
`python -c "import agno, google.genai, structlog, sqlalchemy"` returns no errors.
.env is created from .env.example and GOOGLE_API_KEY is set.
README quick-start steps reproduced end-to-end at least once.

title: Pin agno + verify LLM factory imports
desc: agno's API moves fast. Confirm `agno.models.google.Gemini` constructor signature (id, api_key, vertexai, project_id, location) matches the installed version, and pin in pyproject.
ac:
Installed agno version recorded in pyproject (no broad `>=`).
`build_model()` returns a working Gemini model in both provider modes.
Smoke call: `BaseAgent().run("say hi")` returns text via Gemini API.
If agno renamed/moved Gemini class, llm.py is patched and a comment notes the version it targets.

title: End-to-end smoke: seed → workflow
desc: Prove the full loop works against SQLite with tiny LLM-generated batches.
ac:
`uv run seed-db --customers 3 --products 2 --orders 5` populates dev.db.
`uv run run-workflow daily_db_report` returns status=success.
Final markdown report is rendered in the terminal via rich.
End-to-end run completes in < 60s on `gemini-2.5-flash`.

title: Replace sample schemas with real domain models
desc: Swap the placeholder Customer/Product/Order schemas for whatever actually lives in the target DB.
ac:
`data_generation/schemas.py` updated with real domain types + Field constraints (ranges, regex, enums).
Matching SQLAlchemy ORM models in `db/models.py` are kept in sync (FK, types, indexes).
MockDataFactory generates valid rows that pass pydantic validation 100% of the time across 5 runs of n=20.
Documented mapping table in README: pydantic schema ↔ ORM table.

title: FK-aware mock generation
desc: Make MockDataFactory respect referential integrity when generating dependent tables (e.g. orders.customer_id must point to a real customer).
ac:
`MockDataFactory.generate_with_refs(...)` (or equivalent) accepts a dict of allowed FK values per field.
Prompt includes the allowed value lists so the LLM stays inside them.
Post-generation validation rejects any row with an out-of-range FK and retries up to 3 times.
Unit test: generate 50 orders against 5 fixed customer_ids → assert all FKs valid.

title: Add second concrete workflow
desc: Prove the BaseWorkflow + registry pattern scales by adding a second workflow alongside daily_db_report (e.g. AnomalyAlertWorkflow or WeeklyTrendWorkflow).
ac:
New workflow class registered in `workflows/registry.py`.
`run("<new_name>")` returns a successful WorkflowResult.
Test in `tests/` asserts both workflows are registered and runnable (mocked agent).
README's "Adding a new workflow" section verified by following it for the new one.

title: Tool-call observability
desc: Every agno tool invocation should produce a structured log line so we can trace what the agent did during a workflow run.
ac:
Tool wrapper or callback logs: tool_name, args (truncated), duration_ms, status, error (if any).
Logs include workflow_name + agent_role via structlog contextvars.
`run("daily_db_report")` produces a complete tool-call timeline visible in stdout JSON logs.
Documented in README under an "Observability" section.

title: Containerise with Dockerfile + GKE manifest
desc: Package the scaffold so workflows can run on GKE (or any K8s) on a schedule.
ac:
Multi-stage Dockerfile builds with `uv` and produces a slim runtime image (<300MB).
`k8s/cronjob.yaml` runs `run-workflow daily_db_report` daily at 06:00 UTC.
Secrets (GOOGLE_API_KEY, DATABASE_URL) read from a K8s Secret, not baked in.
Local `docker run` reproduces the same end-to-end output as TICKET-3.

title: Cloud Composer DAG hook
desc: Schedule workflows from Cloud Composer (Airflow on GCP) for production-grade orchestration with retries + alerts.
ac:
`dags/agent_workflows_dag.py` defines a DAG that calls `run("daily_db_report")` via KubernetesPodOperator.
DAG retries 2x with 5-min backoff on failure.
Failure callback posts to a Slack webhook (URL from Airflow Variable).
Deployment instructions in README under "Composer".

title: Vertex AI provider validation
desc: Confirm the `LLM_PROVIDER=vertex` path works end-to-end with ADC, including in-cluster on GKE.
ac:
`gcloud auth application-default login` flow documented in README.
`LLM_PROVIDER=vertex uv run run-workflow daily_db_report` succeeds against a real GCP project.
In-cluster smoke test using a Workload-Identity-bound KSA returns a successful run.
README comparison table: Gemini API vs Vertex (latency, quotas, billing, regions).

title: AgentOS integration for traces & sessions
desc: Wire the existing agents into agno's AgentOS so we get traces, sessions, and a control-plane UI for free.
ac:
`scripts/agent_os.py` builds an AgentOS with all registered agents + workflows.
`fastapi dev scripts/agent_os.py` exposes `http://localhost:8000/docs`.
A full workflow run is visible in the AgentOS UI with per-tool traces.
README documents the dev UX trade-off (AgentOS for debugging, CLI for prod).

title: Multi-agent team variant
desc: Refactor DailyDbReportWorkflow to use an agno Team (DbInspector + Reporter coordinating) instead of sequential single-agent calls — measure quality vs cost.
ac:
New `TeamDailyDbReportWorkflow` registered alongside the original.
Uses `agno.team.Team` with the two existing agents as members.
README table compares: tokens used, wall-clock time, qualitative report quality on the same seeded DB.
Keep both versions — the simple one stays the default.
